cards.text: Zechariah the prophet (Zechariah 1:1) brings the burden of the word of the LORD concerning Israel. It comes from the LORD, who stretches out the heavens, lays the foundation of the earth and forms the spirit of man within him. When THAT is who's talking, friend, you set the cookie tray down and listen.
The LORD says He will make Jerusalem a cup of drunkenness to all the surrounding peoples. And a siege is coming.

cards.question: When the siege comes, Judah will be left alone and only Jerusalem will be besieged.

cards.text: The LORD says that on that day, when all the nations of the earth gather against her, He will make Jerusalem a heavy stone for all the peoples. You know when a friend swears his dresser is "light" and you actually believe him?

cards.question: Jerusalem will be a heavy stone for all the peoples. What will happen to everyone who tries to heave it away?

answers.text: They will break it in pieces

cards.text: On that day, the LORD will strike every horse with panic and every rider with madness. I know that look, friend: that was ME the first time my mixer jumped to high speed.

cards.question: The LORD says He will strike the horses of Judah with blindness.

cards.text: Then the leaders of Judah will say something in their hearts. They will say the people of Jerusalem are their strength.

cards.question: The leaders of Judah will say the people of Jerusalem are their strength. Why?

answers.text: Because the LORD of Hosts is their God
Because Jerusalem has the strongest walls
Because the nations have all gone home

cards.text: Then the LORD will make the clans of Judah like a firepot in a woodpile, like a flaming torch among the sheaves. Friend, I once let parchment paper slide too close to my oven, so I know EXACTLY how this goes.

cards.question: The clans of Judah will be like a firepot in a woodpile. What will happen to the peoples around them?

answers.text: They will be consumed on the right and the left
They will put out the fire of Judah
They will run to Judah for shelter

cards.question: While the clans of Judah consume the peoples around them, the people of Jerusalem will remain secure.

cards.text: The LORD says He will save the tents of Judah first.

cards.question: The LORD will save the tents of Judah first. Why?

answers.text: So King David's family and Jerusalem won't outshine Judah
So Judah can lead the march to Jerusalem
So Judah can rebuild the walls of the city

cards.text: On that day, the LORD will defend the people of Jerusalem.

cards.question: When the LORD defends the people of Jerusalem, even the weakest among them will be like David.

cards.text: Friend, the weakest one in my bakery is me after carrying ONE tray of cookies, and that guy gets to be like DAVID? And the house of David, King David's royal family, will be like God, like the angel of the LORD going before them.

cards.question: So on that day, the LORD will set out to ___ all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

cards.text: Then the LORD says He will pour something out on the house of David and the people of Jerusalem.

cards.question: What does the LORD pour out on the house of David and the people of Jerusalem?

answers.text: A spirit of grace and prayer

cards.text: Then the LORD says they "will look on Me, the One they have pierced." The Gospel of John quotes this line when a soldier pierces Jesus' side at the cross (John 19:34-37).

cards.question: With a spirit of grace and prayer poured out on them, they will look on the One they have pierced and ___ for Him.
The house of David and the people of Jerusalem will mourn for the One they have pierced as one mourns for an only child.

cards.text: They will grieve bitterly for Him as one grieves for a firstborn son. On that day, the wailing in Jerusalem will be as great as the wailing of Hadad-rimmon in the plain of Megiddo.
The land will mourn, each clan on its own with their wives. It starts with the house of David and goes all the way through the remaining clans.
Then, on that day, a fountain will be opened to the house of David and the people of Jerusalem. After all those tears, friend, here comes the turn.

cards.question: The fountain will be opened to the house of David and the people of Jerusalem to cleanse them from ___ and impurity.

cards.text: The LORD of Hosts says He will erase the names of the idols from the land.

cards.question: Once the LORD erases the names of the idols, they will still be remembered in the land.

cards.text: He will also remove the prophets and the spirit of impurity from the land. And if anyone still prophesies, his own father and mother who bore him will step in.

cards.question: A man is still prophesying in the land. What will his father and mother say he has done?

answers.text: Spoken falsely in the name of the LORD
Turned away from working the land
Stolen from the house of the LORD

cards.text: They will tell him he shall not remain alive, and when he prophesies, they will pierce him through. On that day, every prophet who prophesies will be ashamed of his vision.

cards.question: On that day, an ashamed prophet will not put on a hairy cloak in order to deceive.

cards.text: Now the ashamed prophet will say who he is. And friend, that résumé is getting a FULL rewrite.

cards.question: How will the ashamed prophet describe himself?

answers.text: Not a prophet but a servant who works the land
Not a prophet but a priest in the temple
Not a prophet but a merchant from Tarshish

cards.question: Someone asks the ashamed prophet about the wounds on his chest. What will he say?

answers.text: He received them in the house of his friends
He received them while working in the fields
He received them in a battle long ago

cards.text: Then the tone shifts hard. The LORD of Hosts calls a sword to awake against His Shepherd, against the man who is His Companion.

cards.question: The LORD of Hosts says to strike the Shepherd, and the sheep will be ___.

cards.text: And the LORD says He will turn His hand against the little ones. On the night Jesus is arrested, He quotes this line about striking the Shepherd and scattering the sheep (Matthew 26:31).
In all the land, the LORD says, two-thirds will be cut off and perish. But a third will be left in it.

cards.question: The LORD says He will bring the third that is left in the land through the fire. What will He do with them there?

answers.text: Refine them like silver and test them like gold
Burn them away from the land for good
Punish them and then leave them behind

cards.question: The LORD says that when the third left in the land call on His name, He will answer them.
The third left in the land call on the LORD's name. What will He say about them?

cards.text: And they will say, "The LORD is our God." Out of the fire and right into the family, friend.
